name: agents-inc
description: CLI for managing Agents Inc. skills, stacks, and agents for Claude Code
//generate: The write path for all three generators, in dependency order: generate:types reads the skills marketplace and writes src/cli/types/generated/, then generate:schemas copies SKILL_SLUGS and CATEGORIES out of it into metadata.schema.json's enums, then generate:matrix vendors the same directory into packages/matrix. A marketplace change drifts all three, so every caller runs all three — .github/workflows/regenerate-catalog.yml spells the sequence out step by step and could call this instead. It replaces the write path only: the :check variants stay separate because CI deliberately runs different subsets of them in different jobs.
//no-shared-vitest-config: A three-project suite — unit, integration and commands, each with its own include and the retry that separates them — behind one root config that also carries vitest.setup.ts, disableConsoleIntercept for @oclif/test and ink-testing-library, and its own timeouts. @workspace/vitest-config is a single-project node config that turns globals off, which this suite needs on, so merging it in would contradict as much as it contributed. e2e/vitest.config.ts stands under the same decision. Read by scripts/check-shared-vitest-config.ts in packages/cli.
//pretest: The unit suite executes dist/, not just src/: runCliCommand calls oclif's run() with this package as its root, and oclif resolves commands from `oclif.commands.target` — ./dist/commands. So a green `vitest run` is a statement about the last build. It stayed green through CLI-452 with src/cli/commands/import/skill.ts already deleted, eleven specs passing against the orphaned bundle. This hook mirrors pretest:e2e and closes that for `bun run test` and `npm test`. It does NOT close the direct `npx vitest run <file>` this repository's docs are full of — no script hook can — which is why vitest.config.ts also carries a globalSetup that refuses a stale dist outright. Both, not either: the hook keeps the documented command working with no extra step, the guard means no invocation path can produce a green against a build that no longer matches the source. turbo.json already declares test -> dependsOn build, so on the turbo path this is a second tsup pass; measured at 235ms against a ~25s suite, which is the whole cost of the belt.
//test:smoke: The second half of e2e/vitest.config.ts, which is now two named projects over one tree: `test:e2e` runs `*.e2e.test.ts` and this runs `*.smoke.test.ts`. Before this pair existed no command ran the smoke files at all — the old single `include` excluded them, vitest has no `--include` flag, and reaching them took a hand-written config nobody had. Three files sat outside every gate for months and rotted exactly as you would expect: a marketplace fixture the Claude CLI has always rejected sat under a spec named 'should add a marketplace from a local directory source' that had never once added one. It DOES run in CI, and deliberately, even though every describe there is `skipIf(!claudeAvailable)` and the runner has no `claude`: what a fully-skipped run still proves is that the files collect, import and resolve their helpers, which is the whole of what rotted. It is not coverage of the Claude CLI on a runner and must not be reported as such — for that, run it on a machine that has the binary, where all 20 assertions execute in about ten seconds.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit && echo '✓ No TypeScript errors'
scripts.generate: bun run generate:types && bun run generate:schemas && bun run generate:matrix
scripts.generate:schemas:check: bun run generate:schemas && git diff --exit-code src/schemas/
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run generate:schemas:check && bun run generate:types:check && bun run build && bun run test
scripts.generate:types:check: bun run generate:types && git diff --exit-code src/cli/types/generated/

author: Vincent Bollaert
//devDependencies: @workspace/matrix is private and never installed by a consumer, so it is a devDependency and tsup bundles it (see `noExternal`). It is the one home of the seed wire contract, which src/cli/lib/seed/ used to hand-vendor.
